New Zealand Defeats India by 87 Runs in Fourth T20I as Glenn Phillips Smashes 107

New Zealand secured a dominant 87-run victory over India in the fourth T20I of the series. Powered by a brilliant century from Glenn Phillips and a rapid half-century from Michael Bracewell, the visitors posted a formidable first-innings total and subsequently restricted the hosts' batting line-up.

Match Summary and Result

  • Teams: New Zealand vs India
  • Competition: 4th T20I
  • Result: New Zealand won by 87 runs (Completed)
  • First Innings: New Zealand 259/7 in 20 overs
  • Second Innings: India 172/9 in 20 overs

New Zealand Innings: Phillips and Bracewell Shine

Batting first after losing early wickets, New Zealand built their commanding total of 259/7 through aggressive strokeplay. Glenn Phillips led the charge with a spectacular 107 off just 49 deliveries, featuring 10 sixes and four boundaries. Michael Bracewell provided explosive support with 65 runs from 25 balls, hitting six sixes and four fours. Finn Allen contributed 31 off 17 balls, and Daryl Mitchell added 24 off 9 deliveries to maintain a high scoring rate.

For India, Mayank Yadav was the leading wicket-taker with three scalps, while Prince Yadav, Axar Patel, Nitish Kumar Reddy, and Arshdeep Singh claimed one wicket each.

India Run Chase and Bowling Performance

Chasing a daunting target of 260, India's innings struggled to gain momentum as wickets fell at regular intervals. Tilak Varma top-scored with 35 off 35 balls, while Abhishek Sharma made 27 off 15 and Naman Dhir added 28 off 13. Despite brief counter-attacks, India failed to build the substantial partnerships required and finished at 172/9 in their 20 overs.

Jacob Duffy spearheaded New Zealand's bowling attack with an impressive four-wicket haul. Mitchell Santner and Matthew Fisher chipped in with two wickets each, and Adam Milne secured one dismissal to seal the comprehensive victory.

How to Verify
